sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Your strength's just fine, but I can see your endurance needs work. If you're crawling around slow and stopping every few steps, you'll miss all the action. Show me in the Arena that you're not snoozing out there!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Get the first kill of the round 5 times in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +20,000 EXP
- +200 Endurance skill points
- 5 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
